description: One alert with the reasons it fired, like "Why?" on the alerts page: which conditions were true at its candle and which values went in (such as "RSI 14: 28.7"). Computed with the chain as it runs today; consistent=false means the chain changed since. For chains with a take-profit (TP) and stop-loss (SL), alert.trade shows how the alert did as a trade, up to date.

alertId.description: ID of the alert from list_alerts, such as "Xy12ab.1792429200000".

name: explain_alert
title: Why did an alert fire?
